# Repository & document layout {.unnumbered}

*This chapter explains how the repository is organised, so you can find the
inputs, the analysis code, and the documentation.*

## Top-level layout

```
pioneer-shzaed-2021-2022_v18/
├── runs/                     model run directories + RUN_LOG.md
│   ├── 002_P18_flood/
│   └── 003_P18_flood_flat/
├── analytics/                analysis & visualisation code
│   ├── nutrient_budget/      generic mass-balance framework
│   ├── pioneer_region_flux/  Pioneer-specific budget investigation
│   └── animations/           animation tooling (tracer / oxygen / N)
└── docs/                     documentation
    ├── quick-start/          file table + filemap
    └── quarto/               this guide
```

## Run directories

Each `runs/<id>/` holds a complete, self-contained set of model inputs
(`param.nml`, `aed.nml`, mesh, `*.gr3`, `*.ic`, `*.th`, `sflux/`, sources) plus
the `run_schism_vm.sh` launcher. Generated `outputs/` are git-ignored — only a
`.keep` placeholder is tracked. The run-to-run history is in `runs/RUN_LOG.md`.

## Analytics packages

The analysis code is split by transferability:

- **`nutrient_budget/`** — a generic, region-agnostic budget framework (`core/`)
  with no hard-coded run paths. See
  [the budget framework](../part4-nutrient-budget/14-budget-framework.qmd).
- **`pioneer_region_flux/`** — the Pioneer-specific investigation that imports
  that framework, adds run definitions (`run_config.py`), the Pioneer control
  volume, and the diagnostic scripts. See
  [Conservation Testing](../part4-nutrient-budget/16-conservation-testing.qmd).
- **`animations/`** — cross-cutting animation tooling sharing one engine
  (`animlib.py`). See [animations](../part3-model-analysis/13-animations.qmd).

Each package has its own `README.md` with a fuller description.

## Documentation

- **`docs/quick-start/`** — the annotated file table
  ([directory & file structure](../part2-model-setup/05-file-structure.qmd))
  and the file-map figure.
- **`docs/quarto/`** — this guide, built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org)
  (`quarto render` from that folder).
